results.summary: Atlas billing migration: move billing writes from MySQL 5.7 to PostgreSQL 16; analytics stays on MySQL this quarter. Production cutover is fixed for 2026-09-18 02:00–03:00 UTC, with max customer-visible write downtime of 90 seconds. Use logical replication for cutover, but it remains provisional until the 500-writer load test passes; current load-test result is 430 concurrent writers at p95 118 ms, so the requirement (500 concurrent writers at p95 <120 ms) is still unmet. Roll back if replication lag exceeds 30 seconds for 3 consecutive minutes. Success still requires zero checksum mismatches across all 48 tenant shards; a dry run found 2 mismatches and they were fixed, but final verification is still required, and staging replay on 12 representative shards does not validate all 48. Credentials must come from Vault path secret/atlas/prod and not be written to tape; Vault access was validated in staging, but production access is still pending approval. SQLite is allowed only for developer-local fixtures, never staging or production. Mina owns the migration and confirmed availability for the cutover window; Diego is the rollback approver, but has not yet signed the rollback plan. Retention: keep audit events for 400 days and purge raw customer payloads after 7 days.
